hero.description: Market.tj connects farms directly with buyers — no middlemen, markups, or extra days in transit. Just fresh harvest and a fair price.

freshHarvest.title: From harvest to delivery — 18 hours on average
freshHarvest.description: We deliberately limit the time between harvest and delivery. The farmer publishes a listing on the day of harvest, and the courier picks up the order the very next morning — so the product doesn't have time to lose its taste and nutritional value.
